text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day after the year-end wrap-up, Still 
in Love contacted me asking if she could 
borrow the Trainer's office.
choice_data_list:
(I wondered what she was going to do, 
but—)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year. Trainer-san.
choice_data_list: （何をするのかと思ったけど――）
choice_data_list_en: (I wondered what she was going to do, but—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Called in by Still in Love, I arrived at 
the Trainer's Room to find... the room 
decorated for the New Year.
choice_data_list: あけましておめでとう！
choice_data_list_en: Happy New Year!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah... y-yes.
choice_data_list: この飾り……君が？
この飾り……貴方が？
choice_data_list_en: This decoration... was it you?
This decoration... was it you?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Well, um... you've always taken such good 
care of me, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I wanted you to enjoy a festive New Year's 
mood and take some time to relax...
choice_data_list: Still...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Was I... being a bother...?
choice_data_list: スティル……
choice_data_list_en: Still...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
choice_data_list: いや！すごく嬉しい、ありがとう！
ううん！すごく嬉しい、ありがとう！
choice_data_list_en: No, really! I'm so happy, thank you!
Not at all! I'm so happy, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Um, besides the decorations, I also 
prepared a few other things.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Which one will you choose—
choice_data_list:
Of course, I'm going to enjoy every bit of 
it.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah...
choice_data_list: もちろん全部、楽しませてもらうよ
choice_data_list_en: Of course, I'm going to enjoy every single bit of it.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes. In that case... what should we 
start with?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For now, if I were to choose from the 
three Still in Love suggested—
choice_data_list: Read a book recommended by Still.
Eat Still's handmade osechi
Play with Still's handmade otedama

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to take it easy this New Year's. 
Reading a book should help relax my mind 
and body. Besides—
choice_data_list: スティルおすすめの本を読む
スティル手作りおせちを食べる
スティル手作りお手玉で遊ぶ
choice_data_list_en: Read a book Still recommended
Eat Still's homemade osechi
Play with the beanbags Still made

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ! ...Fufu, in that case...
choice_data_list: 君のおすすめ、すごく気になる
貴方のおすすめ、すごく気になる
choice_data_list_en: I'm really curious about your recommendation.
I'm really curious about your recommendation.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I brought a few with me... I really love 
historical novels, you see...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Among our new arrivals, how about this 
one?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
It's the story of a princess who harbored 
a secret during a certain era in Japanese 
history.
choice_data_list: I see... Is the story good?
I see... Is the story good?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah... There's that too, but...
choice_data_list: なるほど……ストーリーがいいのか？
なるほど……ストーリーがいいの？
choice_data_list_en: I see... Is the story that good?
I see... Is the story that good?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...I haven't read it yet. I wanted to read 
it... together with you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sitting side by side with Still in Love, 
reading our books at our own paces... We 
spent a peaceful time together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To my surprise, she apparently made the 
osechi all by herself. Seeing how much 
effort she put in made me want to eat it 
right away.
choice_data_list: I'm really looking forward to it!
I'm really looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah... B-But... please don't get your hopes 
up too high.
choice_data_list: すごく楽しみだ！
すごく楽しみだよ！
choice_data_list_en: I can't wait!
I'm really looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Well, osechi-style, I suppose. It's just 
home-cooked food packed together, 
really...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
The portion isn't that large either. Here, 
please...
choice_data_list: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Opening the bento box she gave me... 
Inside, small portions of traditional 
Japanese dishes like chikuzenni and 
tamagoyaki were neatly packed.
choice_data_list: ありがとう
choice_data_list_en: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Crafted into bite-sized pieces that show 
Still in Love's delicate kindness... Just 
looking at them brings a natural smile to 
my face.
choice_data_list: It really puts the mind at ease...

It really puts your heart at ease, doesn't 
it...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I-Is that so?
choice_data_list: 気持ちが和らぐな……
気持ちが和らぐね……
choice_data_list_en: It really puts the mind at ease...
It really puts the mind at ease...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...I did plenty of taste tests, so please 
go ahead and enjoy...♪

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah... Beanbag juggling...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even she seemed surprised by the result... 
but there was one thing that wouldn't stop 
bugging me.
choice_data_list: Handmade...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I looked into it, and it seemed easy 
enough to make.
choice_data_list: 手作りって……？
choice_data_list_en: Handmade...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Um, I was just trying to come up with 
enough New Year's-themed things to fill 
out the numbers, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The handmade beanbags she timidly handed 
over... were made with ribbons, lace, and 
other adorable patterns—
choice_data_list: That's so like you, Still. Cute.
That's so like you, Still — so cute!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
choice_data_list: スティルらしくてかわいいな
スティルらしくてかわいいね
choice_data_list_en: That's so like you, it's adorable.
That's so like you, it's adorable.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Hu- Ah... Uh, yes, sir...!
choice_data_list: ちょっとやってみてくれる？
choice_data_list_en: Could you give it a try?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Um... throw it upward and—kyaa! ...Then, a 
little lower—aaah! ...Uu... H-How 
embarrassing...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dropping it on her head, sending it flying 
far away... Still in Love was looking a 
bit clumsy.
